args.message:
Fix money.py to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The docstring claims banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly
build (e.g. 2.665 should round to 2.66, not 2.67).

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of `tests/test_money.py` failed because `src/money.py` claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring but actually used ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money()`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py now expects 2.675 → 2.68 and 2.665 → 2.66, which banker's rounding produces).

Needed so this fix ships in today's release.
